name: After recital F
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2025
part_text: Fb. whereas following the United States’s January 2026 military intervention in Venezuela, the Trump administration reiterated its ambition to annex Greenland, including possibly through military intervention; whereas this represents a fundamental threat to the rules-based international order, the EU’s strategic security interests and the transatlantic alliance, and shows a blatant disdain for fundamental principles of international law, including the principle of non-aggression towards sovereign nations;
